The structural integrity of the white cream piping looks slightly unnatural, with soft, melting edges that don't fully hold their shape against gravity.

selected_experts.reason: To verify if the specific food items are recognized as valid bakery products (e.g., distinguishing real pastries from AI-hallucinated food shapes).
To analyze the realism of the glass reflections and refractions, which are common failure points in AI-generated display cases.
To check for boundary bleeding between the pastries and the tray, ensuring objects are physically grounded and not floating or merging.

focus_areas: Realism of food textures (glaze, crumb, cream)
Physical grounding of objects on the tray
Consistency of glass reflections and refractions
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'plastic' sheen on the pastries. AI often struggles with the translucency of fruit glazes and the porosity of baked crusts. Verify if the reflections on the glass match the geometry of the room implied by the light sources.
